{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Green Onion|scallions]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]], plus more for garnish
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] roughly-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallot]], sliced
* 1 scotch bonnet [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile]], stemmed and seeded
* Juice of 1 [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]], plus wedges for serving
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]], to taste
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|beef chuck]], cut into ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] pieces
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] olive oil
* 8 cups beef [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], cut into 1½-inch pieces
* 2 stalks [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], cut into 1½-inch pieces
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Leek|leek]], trimmed, halved lengthwise and cut into 1½-inch pieces; rinsed
* 1 small yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], cut into 1½-inch pieces
* 1 large Yukon gold [[Cookbook:Potato|potato]], peeled and cut into 1½-inch pieces
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Turnip|turnip]], peeled and cut into 1½-inch pieces
* ½ small green [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]], cored and cut into 1½-inch pieces
* ½ small calabaza or kabocha [[Cookbook:Squash|squash]], cut into 1-inch pieces

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] garlic, scallions, parsley, thyme, shallots, chile, juice, salt and pepper, and ½ cup water in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] until smooth; mix with beef in a bowl, cover with [[Cookbook:Plastic wrap|plastic wrap]], and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
# Remove beef from marinade and dry with [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]]; set aside.
# Heat oil in a 8 [[Cookbook:Quart|qt]] [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium-high heat. Add beef; cook, turning as needed, until browned, about 8 minutes. Add stock and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]; reduce heat to medium, and cook, stirring occasionally, until beef is tender, about 1½ hours. Add carrots, celery, leeks, onion, potatoes, turnips, and cabbage; cook, slightly covered and stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
# Meanwhile, bring squash and 2 cups water to a boil in a 2 qt saucepan over high heat; reduce heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until squash is tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, reserving ½ cup cooking liquid and transfer squash and liquid to a blender; purée until smooth and set aside. When vegetables are tender, uncover, and stir in reserved squash purée; cook, stirring occasionally, until soup is slightly thick, 5–10 minutes more
# Season soup with salt and pepper and serve with scallions and lime wedges.
